summary.headline: Treya delivers $1.24M in fully-finalized annual savings across five spend categories for Christianbook
summary.narrative: Through competitive RFPs, incumbent renegotiations, and carrier trials, Treya Partners secured $1,237,359 in recurring annual savings for Christianbook across Merchant Processing, LTL/FTL freight, Corrugated, and Packaging Supplies. All five categories are contracted and implemented, preserving service continuity while reducing costs by an average of 13%. The rapid, data-driven sourcing approach translated to material EBITDA lift and an estimated $11M in enterprise value.
